description: Defines the 'Element' class for the Goteo SuperForm library, representing form elements with rendering and property management.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a form element with properties, rendering capabilities, and array access implementation.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by name.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets the value of a property by name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Element object with provided data, sets type and view, and manages errors.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Determines the view path for rendering the element.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the element based on class name.

methods.name: getInnerHTML
methods.description: Returns the inner HTML content, either from 'content' or by rendering the view.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to create and render an Element from data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the element using a view template.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the element to string by rendering; terminates on exception.
